plugins.name: dazzer
plugins.description: Makes your AI check your Dazzer Brain before it answers, and save decisions and facts as they come up. Safe beside an existing connection: it adds none of its own.

plugins.name: dazzer-connect
plugins.description: The Dazzer Brain connection itself, which the reminders need. Signing in is a separate step: see the install guide.

plugins.name: dazzer-antigravity
plugins.description: The Dazzer reminders in the one shape Antigravity accepts. Only for Antigravity, and only alongside the main plugin - every other tool reads its reminders from that one.

plugins.name: dazzer-plate
plugins.description: Your plate in a pane beside the chat, in Claude Code only: what needs you now, what waits on someone else, what is coming up. Opens only when you type /plate, and reads through the Dazzer connection you already have.
